author: PokerFace
body:
Hello all, Predators Clan is dying and will most likely be disbanded so, I will make this LFT in advance.

I'm a very good rusher and, I have managed to get 57 monuments in the timecourse of 1 day. I can Quick-Bridge (shift-unshift) and, I can no-shift staircase. I can also Wall-Jump with success. I also have decent pvp skills so if you need to test me, just 1v1 me. I have a .93 Pvp K/D and this is due to my rushing. Sometimes you guys see me in-game so you may have some knowledge of what I can or cannot do. I also have very good parkour skills so, I can navigate terrain without losing sprint so, this would be highly useful for maps like Teres. I can MLG water place as well for skybridges and such. I've been playing for 18 days now so I am definetly experienced and active. I am also very proficient with sniping moving targets. 

My computer is not the best. 4GB Ram with an Intel Pentium Processor doesn't have superb fps but, it's manageable. I will be getting a new one soon. 

Anyways so... if you have any interest, just leave something down below. I'm a really friendly guy and, I can help out with technical things. I do have skype and if needed, can make a Slack. Thanks!

BTW my timezone is HST. (Hawaii Standard Time)

~PokerFace
